title: Sunvault Climb - Vines to the Sky
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band. overworld preset. Radiant D major, 112 BPM, 4/4, 24 bars (~26s). Bright ascending broken-chord lead that keeps stepping up; harp-like pluck arpeggio rolling upward (pulse12, Solar warmth + Light sparkle); purposeful walking-pace bass; brisk steady kick-snare-hat. Vesper motif bounced AND made to climb: the rising leap A3->D4->E4 becomes an arpeggiated launch, sequenced up a step higher each phrase (A->D->E ... B->E->F# ... C#->F#->G#) so the whole loop ascends toward the Observatory; settle home each phrase. Last bar (A7 arp + bass A->D pickup) voice-leads to bar 1.

tracks._note: Vesper climbing: each A-phrase launches the rising leap (overshoot) then settles; phrases sequence upward to feel like ascent.
